title: iTrace: verification-first webcam eye-movement analysis
description: iTrace 0.5.0 is an MIT-licensed Python toolkit for webcam-derived gaze, saccade, pupil, and quality diagnostics. This minor release strengthens irregular-time analysis, missing-data handling, immutable recording inputs, pupil preprocessing, configuration and report contracts, reproducible live exports, manuscript rendering, and release verification. The NumPy/SciPy core is algorithmically verified against synthetic and independently formulated closed-loop oracles. Empirical figures reuse preserved summaries from a single-participant, single-device, five-session diagnostic pilot. This release does not claim reference-device accuracy, cross-device generality, population generality, or webcam-accuracy validation.
